rules.reason: Coinbase's tokenized stocks are offered under Regulation S, only in eligible jurisdictions outside the United States.
rules.short: Coinbase's tokenized stocks aren't offered in the US.

rules.reason: Each token is a 1:1 claim on a real share held at Alpaca, issued by Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd (ADGM). Coinbase offers them only to non-US persons in 'eligible jurisdictions' but does not publish which countries are eligible, so whether this country is one could not be confirmed.
rules.short: You can buy it onchain, but Coinbase only offers it in jurisdictions it doesn't name.

acknowledgement.limit: holding it lawfully and dealing with Coinbase as issuer
acknowledgement.requires: being in a jurisdiction Coinbase permits (its list is not published)
